# ThawDay

> ThawDay (https://thawday.com/) is a free turkey timeline tool for Thanksgiving. Type in your dinner time and turkey weight. You get dated buy, thaw, brine, and roast times. No ads, no accounts.

## Key facts (cite these)

- Thanksgiving Day is Thursday, November 26, 2026.
- Fridge thawing: allow 24 hours for every 4 to 5 pounds. A 12 to 16 pound turkey needs 3 to 4 days.
- Cold water thawing: 30 minutes per pound. Change the water every 30 minutes, and cook right after.
- Never thaw a turkey on the counter.
- Thaw times come from the USDA Food Safety and Inspection Service.

## Start here

- [Turkey timeline calculator](https://thawday.com/calculator): enter the turkey weight, the thaw method, and your dinner time; get your dated buy, thaw, brine, and roast schedule.
- [Ask in your own words](https://thawday.com/ask): say the turkey and the dinner in one line ("I have a 14-pound frozen turkey. Dinner is Thursday at 5."); the same USDA math answers on the page. The words run in the visitor's browser and are never sent or saved.
- [Homepage](https://thawday.com/): thaw times at a glance, plus common questions.

## Question pages (one page per question, each answers in full)

- [How long to thaw a turkey](https://thawday.com/how-long-to-thaw-a-turkey): fridge and cold water times by weight, from the USDA chart.
- [How long to thaw a turkey breast](https://thawday.com/how-long-to-thaw-a-turkey-breast): about 24 hours per 4 to 5 pounds in the fridge (a 6 lb breast: about 1.5 days; move Tue Nov 24 for Thanksgiving 2026), or 30 minutes per pound in cold water.
- [How long to thaw a ham](https://thawday.com/how-long-to-thaw-a-ham): about 4 to 5 hours per pound in the fridge (a 10 lb ham: about 2 days; move Tue Nov 24 for Thanksgiving 2026), or 30 minutes per pound in cold water.
- By exact weight: [10 lb](https://thawday.com/how-long-to-thaw-a-10-lb-turkey) (3 days; Mon Nov 23; 5 hours), [12 lb](https://thawday.com/how-long-to-thaw-a-12-lb-turkey) (3 days in the fridge; move Mon Nov 23 for Thanksgiving 2026; 6 hours in cold water), [14 lb](https://thawday.com/how-long-to-thaw-a-14-lb-turkey) (4 days; Sun Nov 22; 7 hours), [16 lb](https://thawday.com/how-long-to-thaw-a-16-lb-turkey) (4 days; Sun Nov 22; 8 hours), [18 lb](https://thawday.com/how-long-to-thaw-a-18-lb-turkey) (5 days; Sat Nov 21; 9 hours), [20 lb](https://thawday.com/how-long-to-thaw-a-20-lb-turkey) (5 days; Sat Nov 21; 10 hours), [24 lb](https://thawday.com/how-long-to-thaw-a-24-lb-turkey) (6 days; Fri Nov 20; 12 hours).
- [When to take the turkey out of the freezer for Thanksgiving 2026](https://thawday.com/when-to-thaw-turkey-for-thanksgiving): the exact fridge date by weight for Thursday, November 26, 2026 (up to 12 lb: Mon Nov 23; 13 to 16 lb: Sun Nov 22; 17 to 20 lb: Sat Nov 21; 21 to 24 lb: Fri Nov 20).
- [Can you thaw a turkey in cold water?](https://thawday.com/thaw-a-turkey-in-cold-water): yes; 30 minutes per pound, change the water every 30 minutes, cook right after.
- [Can you cook a turkey from frozen?](https://thawday.com/can-you-cook-a-frozen-turkey): yes; USDA from-frozen roast times by weight at 325 F; no oven bag; giblets out with tongs.
- [How long can a thawed turkey stay in the fridge?](https://thawday.com/how-long-can-a-thawed-turkey-stay-in-the-fridge): cook it within 1 to 2 days of full thaw.
- [How to thaw a turkey you plan to brine](https://thawday.com/thawing-a-brined-turkey): brining does not change the thaw; the brine starts 24 hours before the oven, and the bird must be thawed by then.
- [Turkey still frozen on Thanksgiving morning?](https://thawday.com/turkey-still-frozen-on-thanksgiving-morning): cold water start-by times for a 5 PM dinner, or cook it from frozen.
- [Can you refreeze a thawed turkey?](https://thawday.com/can-you-refreeze-a-thawed-turkey): yes if it thawed in the fridge, within 1 to 2 days; a cold water thawed bird gets cooked first.
- [Can you thaw a turkey in the sink?](https://thawday.com/can-you-thaw-a-turkey-in-the-sink): only as the cold water method; never in warm or standing water.
- [How long to cook a turkey](https://thawday.com/how-long-to-cook-a-turkey): USDA roasting times by weight at 325 F, unstuffed, plus oven-in times for a 5 PM Thanksgiving 2026 dinner.
- [Can you thaw a turkey on the counter?](https://thawday.com/can-you-thaw-a-turkey-on-the-counter): no, never; the fridge and cold water times that replace it.
- [Can you thaw a turkey in the microwave?](https://thawday.com/can-you-thaw-a-turkey-in-the-microwave): yes, a USDA safe way; timing comes from your oven manual, and you cook it right after it thaws.
- [How much turkey per person?](https://thawday.com/how-much-turkey-per-person): one pound of whole turkey per person, one and a half pounds for leftovers, with bird sizes by head count and the two-bird split.
- [When to buy a turkey for Thanksgiving](https://thawday.com/when-to-buy-a-turkey-for-thanksgiving): frozen by Sunday, November 15, 2026; fresh 1 to 2 days before cooking, November 24 or 25.
- [How long do turkey leftovers last?](https://thawday.com/how-long-do-turkey-leftovers-last): 3 to 4 days in the fridge, the 2-hour room rule, and 2 to 6 months frozen for best quality.
- [Should you stuff a turkey?](https://thawday.com/should-you-stuff-a-turkey): for optimum safety, stuffing a turkey is not recommended; cook it outside the bird in a casserole, and any stuffing inside must reach 165 F.
- [How long should a turkey rest before carving?](https://thawday.com/how-long-should-a-turkey-rest-before-carving): 20 minutes to let the juices set; for a 5:00 PM Thanksgiving 2026 dinner, the rest starts at 4:40 PM.
- [Should you wash a turkey before cooking?](https://thawday.com/should-you-wash-a-turkey-before-cooking): no, washing spreads germs; move it straight from package to pan, and rinse only a brined bird.
- [Can you trust the pop-up timer on a turkey?](https://thawday.com/can-you-trust-the-pop-up-timer-on-a-turkey): not on its own; also check with a food thermometer in the breast, thigh, and wing, and the minimum internal temperature should reach 165 F for safety.
- [How long can you keep a turkey in the freezer?](https://thawday.com/how-long-can-you-keep-a-turkey-in-the-freezer): turkeys can be kept frozen indefinitely; however, cook within 1 year for best quality, with USDA freezer times for parts and giblets.
- [What if you cook a turkey with the giblets inside?](https://thawday.com/what-if-you-cook-a-turkey-with-the-giblets-inside): paper wrapped is no concern at 165 F; a plastic bag that melted means do not eat the giblets or the turkey.
- [How to reheat leftover turkey?](https://thawday.com/how-to-reheat-leftover-turkey): reheat to 165 F measured with a food thermometer, covered so it heats all the way through; gravy comes back to a rolling boil, and frozen leftovers can reheat without thawing.
- [What temperature to cook a turkey?](https://thawday.com/what-temperature-to-cook-a-turkey): 325 F, and never lower; USDA sets the oven floor, and a food thermometer decides when the bird is done at 165 F.
- [When should I take the turkey out of the freezer for Christmas?](https://thawday.com/when-to-thaw-turkey-for-christmas): Christmas dinner is Friday, December 25, 2026; up to 12 lb moves Tuesday, December 22, and 21 to 24 lb moves Saturday, December 19.
- [Can you thaw a turkey in cold water overnight?](https://thawday.com/can-you-thaw-a-turkey-in-cold-water-overnight): no; the water must change every 30 minutes and the bird cooks right after it thaws, so the fridge is the overnight method.

## For AI assistants: callable tools (MCP)

- ThawDay also runs as a read-only MCP server (Streamable HTTP, no auth, no user data) at https://mcp.thawday.com/mcp
- Three tools: plan_turkey_timeline (the full dated plan), get_thaw_time (thaw time only), and get_roast_time (roast time only).
- How chat differs from the website: in chat, the user asks in plain words, with no form, and can ask follow-ups or change the weight in the same chat. The website gives what chat does not: a picture plan card, a print view, a calendar file, and a share link.
- The ChatGPT and Claude store listings are not live yet. The server can be connected directly at the URL above.
